CreatorProfile.title: CreatorProfile
CreatorProfile.description: Authenticated creator profile and default generation preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

preferredLanguage.description: Default target language for Viral Growth Kits.

fcmToken.description: Latest Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for push delivery.

fcmNicheTopic.description: Subscribed FCM topic matching the creator's niche.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was updated.

ViralGrowthKit.title: ViralGrowthKit
ViralGrowthKit.description: Structured Viral Growth Kit generated by Gemini for a creator video, audio, or script.

title.description: Short label or YouTube Shorts title for the kit.

mediaLabel.description: Filename or context summary of the analyzed input.

modelUsed.description: Gemini model identifier used for generation.

diagnosisCritique.description: Constructive 2-sentence critique on pacing or delivery.

first30sStrategy.description: Recommended engagement hook strategy for the first 30 seconds.

pacingSegments.description: Timestamped B-roll, on-screen text, zoom cuts, and SFX guide.

youtubeTitle.description: High-CTR YouTube Shorts title under 60 characters.

rawJson.description: Valid JSON output matching the Viral Growth Kit schema.

trendingTopics.description: Trending industry topics discovered via Google Search Grounding.

trendingTagSources.description: Google Search Grounding source links supporting extracted topic tags.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when kit was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when kit was updated.

ChatMessageRecord.title: ChatMessageRecord
ChatMessageRecord.description: Persisted multi-turn chat message with the Gemini Viral Content Strategist.

role.description: Speaker role in the Gemini multi-turn chat.

modelId.description: Gemini model used for this turn.

thinkingSummary.description: Optional thought summary returned by thinking mode.

groundingSources.description: Optional Google Search grounding source citations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when message was recorded.

TaggedContentIdea.title: TaggedContentIdea
TaggedContentIdea.description: Recorded creator idea automatically tagged with trending industry topics via Google Search Grounding.

ideaText.description: Recorded voice transcript or content idea note.

sourceType.description: How the content idea was captured.

industryNiche.description: Creator industry or niche context used for Search Grounding.

extractedKeywords.description: Core keywords extracted from the recorded idea.

trendingTopics.description: Live trending industry topics discovered via Google Search Grounding.

groundingRationale.description: Brief rationale connecting the recorded idea to surging industry trends.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tagged idea was saved.

StrategySession.title: StrategySession
StrategySession.description: Metadata for a persisted multi-turn AI strategy conversation session.

title.description: Display title of the strategy session.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview snippet of the latest message in the session.

modelId.description: Last Gemini strategist model ID used in this session.

language.description: Target content language for this session.

platform.description: Target short-form platform for this session.

messageCount.description: Total number of persisted messages in this session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when session was last active.

/users/{userId}.description: Private creator profile and default preferences.

/users/{userId}/taggedIdeas/{ideaId}.description: User-owned recorded content ideas tagged with trending industry topics.

/users/{userId}/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: Legacy single-thread multi-turn strategist chat history.

/users/{userId}/strategySessions/{sessio.description: Persisted multi-turn messages belonging to a specific AI strategy session.
